question: Which phase-sensitive observations can be implemented by ordinary operations on the four words of one even-parity knot?
forbidden_inputs: No quantum amplitudes, distant settings, declared trial order, outcome labels, or prior transcript enter the candidate update rules. No discarded trials. Explicitly label each extra record.
primary_observable: Full joint distributions in all six orders, repeatability, the six one-reader preparations and the best success for a calibrated quarter turn.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Hold the order fixed, supply one common fair writable bit, freeze its value, or prepare its value deterministically. Compare a lawful four-cycle with the pulse holding the reference fixed.
first_executable_signal: Apply one changed reader in two orders relative to a read of another mark. Score all four inputs in a fixed-order example, then repeat a changed read in the shared-bit example.
resource_budget: One exact census of 110592 candidates and finite verification, a few CPU seconds at a time, less than 512 MiB per process.
stop_rule: Stop on a certified isolated-word obstruction or counterexample and reproduce the declared positive controls with their first failure or scope limit.
decision_or_followup_rule: Close the isolated-word test when results are reconciled. Distinguish any richer source of phase or physical reader from this test and from an added shared record.
nonclaims: No derivation of quantum physics, physical space, a Born rule, a measurement forced by K1–K3, or an impossibility theorem over richer logical preparations.
